reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open of the Accountable dashboard API on 2026-07-27T22:45:43.737Z (payload ts 1785192343737) reports reserves_split USD values STRC 189087988.65, Protocol Owned Liquidity 48810415.17, Inventory 39967447.71, Cash & Equivalents 30725438.26, and Other 8820.91 against total_reserves 308600110.7. Normalized with the live accountable adapter's one-decimal largest-slice remainder rule (Other rounds out at 0.003%), the mix is 61.2% STRC, 15.8% Protocol Owned Liquidity, 13.0% Inventory, and 10.0% Cash & Equivalents. The same payload reports collateralization 0.922477 (~7.75% deficit vs total_supply 327073514.82); the normalized composition is a mix of disclosed reserves only and must not be read as 100% liability coverage. Re-opened Apyx STRC docs still identify STRC as Strategy, Inc. perpetual preferred equity (Nasdaq STRC); transparency docs still designate the Accountable dashboard as the near-real-time reserve surface. Protocol Owned Liquidity and Inventory remain undisclosed baskets under the Apyx protocol failure domain; Cash & Equivalents still combines USDC and U.S. T-Bills without a split.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: USDC cannot be isolated from Treasury backing in Cash & Equivalents, while the source-native Protocol Owned Liquidity and Inventory buckets do not disclose their constituent assets.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Apyx states it works with custodians monthly to obtain attestations that backing assets exist and remain under custody control (Wolf & Company opinions published for March-June 2026 on the third-party attestation index), but the custodian identities, account segregation terms, bankruptcy-remoteness structure, and rehypothecation permissions are not disclosed in the reviewed documentation. The Protocol Owned Liquidity and Inventory buckets (28.8% of the 2026-07-27 reserves_split) are protocol-controlled with no stated custody arrangement.
